title: What Counts as an Activity?
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Decide whether fourteen everyday commitments, from jobs and family duties to hobbies, belong on your activities list, and see which activity type each would go under.

learningObjectives: Students will classify everyday commitments as listable activities or not and explain which activity type each belongs to and why.

keyQuestions: Why do family responsibilities count as activities?
What makes a paid summer program weaker than a part-time job on an application?
When does a hobby become an activity?
commonMisconceptions: Expensive programs impress readers more than jobs or family duties.
assessmentOpportunities: Students correctly classify at least nine of the eleven clear-cut cards and explain one gray-area card's condition.
